capabilities: Generate each day's tasks into an output note from level-6 headings in a TaskFile
Rotate through [cyclic] task lists so a set number of tasks appear per day
Move completed tasks under a Done heading and manage the #active tag
Stamp done and cancelled tasks with today's date automatically
Insert due dates through a typing menu with quick date options
extras: Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry; date-stamp features step aside automatically when the Tasks plugin is enabled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically create recurring or rotating routine tasks each day from lists you write once.

relations.evidence: I recommend installing Tasks plugin as it really helps you organize.
Clockwork Tasks builds the habit. Taskscape shows the progress.

summary: Task scheduler that generates recurring and rotating tasks from Markdown lists into an output note, with done/cancelled date stamps and a due-date menu.
